evidence: Short-term news coverage leading into May 3, 2022 highlights a cautious, range-bound market awaiting the upcoming Federal Reserve policy announcement. Technical analysts note downside risk following a break below key $40,000 support levels, while on-chain reports suggest underlying institutional accumulation has kept prices consolidating sideways. General sentiment is weighed down by macro uncertainty ahead of the Fed rate hike decision, tilting the 24-hour balance slightly toward defensive or flat-to-lower price action.
limitations: Multiple articles regarding Warren Buffett's criticism of Bitcoin reflect recurring sentiment narratives rather than direct short-term price catalysts and were grouped as a single background sentiment factor.
Hardware and altcoin-specific items were excluded as non-direct drivers of 24-hour BTC price movement.
